block.ostentum.dragon_relic.no_room: The Ender Dragon Relic needs a clear 3x3 space
message.ostentum.enchanted_rise: The Enchanted Moon rises. Enchanting costs no levels tonight.
message.ostentum.glimmer_rise: The Glimmer Moon rises. Mobs and ores give double experience tonight.
message.ostentum.harvest_rise: The Harvest Moon rises. Ripe crops yield double tonight.
item.ostentum.vine_whip.desc: A tip hit snags the target and yanks it toward you.
item.ostentum.glow_berry_whip.desc: Hits outline the target in glow-berry orange.
item.ostentum.silk_whip.desc: Every hit webs the target (Slowness II).
item.ostentum.ender_whip.desc: Every hit lifts the target (Levitation, 1 s).
item.ostentum.end_rift_whip.desc: Its cord is a slit into the End.
item.ostentum.leather_whip.desc: The plain whip, the one the others are made from.
item.ostentum.chain_whip.desc: A tip hit wraps the target in chain (Slowness II, 2 s).
item.ostentum.golden_heavy_whip.desc: The slowest, hardest-hitting swing; it knocks hard.
item.ostentum.diamond_whip.desc: The cord hits light; the bladed tip hits hard.
item.ostentum.emerald_whip.desc: Each crack fires three homing emerald bolts.
item.ostentum.amethyst_whip.desc: A tip hit shatters into five crystal shards that fly on through.
item.ostentum.royal_slime_whip.desc: Bounces what it hits. Quick hits stack up to five,
item.ostentum.destruction_whip.desc: Each crack fires four lasers at nearby hostiles.
item.ostentum.thunderstorm_whip.desc: A tip hit arcs to five more hostiles in sight and stuns each.
item.ostentum.breeze_whip.desc: The fastest whip. Every hit blows the target away;
item.ostentum.blaze_whip.desc: Sets what it hits on fire, and cuts 40% deeper into burning foes.
item.ostentum.amethyst_hook.desc: Three seconds of Slow Falling when it lets go.
item.ostentum.netherite_hook.desc: The longest reach and fastest pull.
item.ostentum.diamond_hook.desc: Longer reach and a faster pull than amethyst.
item.ostentum.guardian_totem.desc: Saves you from death once per day; grey until sunrise.
item.ostentum.royal_slime_whip.desc2: each cutting two ticks off the cooldown.
item.ostentum.breeze_whip.desc2: a tip hit bursts like a wind charge.
item.ostentum.blaze_whip.desc2: The tip lights campfires and candles it strikes.
item.ostentum.thunderstorm_whip.desc2: Made by lightning striking a dropped Golden Heavy Whip.
item.ostentum.untamed_sea_whip.desc2: Hold use to charge a crashing wave.
item.ostentum.stillwind_hook.desc: Hangs you dead still between its two hooks.
item.ostentum.stillwind_hook.desc2: Found only in trial chamber vaults.
item.ostentum.weeping_vine_whip.desc: Every hit heals you half a heart, a tip hit a full heart.
item.ostentum.twisting_vine_whip.desc: A tip hit throws the target up into the air.
item.ostentum.weathervane_spear.desc: Sprint to build static; the next hit shocks the target and one mob near it.
item.ostentum.weathervane_spear.desc2: A jab on a button, lever, door, trapdoor, gate or lamp powers it for a second.
item.ostentum.weathervane_spear.desc3: Found only in trial chamber vaults.
item.ostentum.pathfinders_glaive.desc: Use on the ground to plant it as a waypoint, glowing through walls.
item.ostentum.pathfinders_glaive.desc2: Hold it to see how far away it is; use again, from anywhere, to pull it back.
item.ostentum.duelists_saber.desc: Use to parry: blocks a melee hit or a shot from the front and staggers the attacker.
item.ostentum.duelists_saber.desc2: Your next hit within a second is a 1.5x riposte. A missed parry costs a second.
item.ostentum.cold_hearthblade.desc: Set it on a lit campfire to rekindle it.
item.ostentum.cold_hearthblade.desc2: A soul campfire wakes its blue flame.
item.ostentum.hearthblade.desc: Kills cook their drops and store an ember (half a food point, up to 10).
item.ostentum.hearthblade.desc2: Sneak + use to eat the embers.
item.ostentum.soul_hearthblade.desc: Kills cook their drops in soul fire (one extra) and store an ember.
item.ostentum.soul_hearthblade.desc2: Sneak + use to eat the embers.
item.ostentum.echo_blade.desc: Every hit echoes 1.5 s later for half its damage.
item.ostentum.echo_blade.desc2: While you sneak, its hits and kills make no vibrations.
item.ostentum.resonant_hilt.desc: Smith it onto a netherite sword with an echo shard.
item.ostentum.frostbite_hatchet.desc: Use to throw it; it comes back.
item.ostentum.frostbite_hatchet.desc2: Freezes water under its path; hit mobs start freezing.
item.ostentum.bloom_bow.desc: Arrows that land bonemeal a 3x3 patch.
item.ostentum.bloom_bow.desc2: Arrows that hit your pets or allies heal them instead.
item.ostentum.voidstring_bow.desc: Arrows ignore gravity and curve toward mobs; a hit gives Levitation.
item.ostentum.voidstring_bow.desc2: A fully drawn hit swaps your place with the mob (4 s cooldown).
item.ostentum.engineers_crossbow.desc2: Combat: five bolts a load. Rope: two bolts string a rope you can ride while holding it.
item.ostentum.bastion_crossbow.desc: Loads fast and fires three bolts; landed bolts leave soul fire.
item.ostentum.bastion_crossbow.desc2: Load a fire charge to shoot a flame bolt that lights campfires, candles, TNT and portals.
item.ostentum.fisher_kings_trident.desc: Thrown into water, it brings back a catch (Luck of the Sea counts).
item.ostentum.coral_trident.desc: Landing underwater, it leaves a whirlpool that pulls you to it.
item.ostentum.coral_trident.desc2: Hits on coral or kelp grow them.
item.ostentum.abyssal_trident.desc: Where it lands, a drowning field: mobs lose air even on land.
item.ostentum.quake_hammer.desc: Sneak + attack the ground: a fissure runs 8 blocks ahead, throwing up all on it.
item.ostentum.quake_hammer.desc2: Hits like a mace, without the fall damage.
item.ostentum.delvers_pick.desc: Mines a 1x3 line; sneak to mine one block.
item.ostentum.dormant_delvers_pick.desc: Throw it through a Nether portal to wake it.
item.ostentum.rusted_delvers_head.desc: Smith it onto a diamond pickaxe.
item.ostentum.rusted_delvers_head.desc2: Found in abandoned mineshafts, more often deep down.
item.ostentum.recall_chime.desc: Ring to set a mark; ring again to be pulled back to it (same dimension).
item.ostentum.recall_chime.desc2: Costs XP: 1 point per 16 blocks (5 to 60). Sneak to move the mark.
item.ostentum.phantom_veil.desc: Worn on the back. In the dark, mobs notice you from half as far.
item.ostentum.phantom_veil.desc2: Phantoms never come for you; sneaking, you are only a shimmer from afar.
item.ostentum.pathfinders_glaive.elsewhe: Your waypoint is in another dimension
